rationale: The discourse has become highly structured and process-oriented, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee-side actors still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist these must remain available if needed. The last two rounds added a site-by-site modeling process and expert framing, yet no party has moved off its fundamental red lines, so further direct debate is likely to circle without substantive convergence unless an external intervention changes the format.
